notes.title: Another patch just committed
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I tracked down another issue which started to happen more often now - 
sometimes interface got stuck for no particular reason on the screen. I managed to implement a fix which should help. If your savegame has this issue, please return to probe and back on the planet. This should fix your savegames.

All the best in 2017!

Jan

notes.title: German version and DLC just arrived!
notes.notes:
After incredible wait we're back with a fully german version and DLC. 

To switch the language version, access properties of the game and on the "languages" tab switch the language. Be warned that it's a long download, though.

Also you might notice that a DLC is being available. It contains game soundtrack, beautiful hintbook and as a bonus a game called J.U.L.I.A.: Untold. It's a puzzle game based upon the blueprint construction puzzle from J.U.L.I.A.: Among the Stars and offering 5 unique pieces of story before the game actually happened. 

I hope you will like it and happy listening / gaming!

-- Jan

notes.title: Upcoming update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

it's been a long time and some of you might have suspected that we disappeared. Quite the opposite! We can't be working harder but unfortunately things got a bit complicated.

Let me fill you up with the news:

1. we are currently beta testing german version of J.U.L.I.A.: Among the Stars. This will be a free update for everyone requiring just a version switch. However - it's a full localization with well over 40 000 words and fully voiced. 
It took us almost half a year to get it in shape and there are still things to fix!

This brought an extra set of problems and I had to seriously touch the game core to be able to fully localize it. Which brings me to the following issue:

2. Bug fixes. So far I am trying my best to fix your savegames so please keep them coming. However some of emails come back as undeliverable. If you didn't receive your fix, please chime in. BUT! I will also pull out a cumulative patch which will hopefully fix all the issues. At this point however doing it could totally ruin your game as the huge changes due to a german version needs to be properly retested in English version so I can publish the game without having to bite all my fingernails off. 

3. Lots of you asked me for a soundtrack! Some of you question the one missing achievement. Don't worry, it is not not part of J.U.L.I.A.: Among the Stars. Unfortunately Steam doesn't let me make it invisible or split it as DLC only. This achievement is connected to a gift hidden inside the planned Soundtrack / Hintbook DLC. :)

So please stay tuned, it's coming albeit I wish it was out there already a few months ago.

Thank you everyone and enjoy the game!

-- Jan

notes.title: Version update
notes.notes:
I would like to thank all the players for joining J.U.L.I.A.: Among the Stars universe. It's incredible to see fan contents pouring in. It's also frustrating to see how some of you have to suffer some of the bugs which slipped by my tired eyes. Rest assured that I do address them as fast as possible. 

Those of you who sent me savegames are getting these back fixed and I hope you continue enjoying the game. 

I've just commited fixes to the following issues:

[spoiler]
- Museum scripture window no longer stays on screen if you exit via the probe skip (actually this option was a bug) and instead you can correctly access interface help question mark.

- StarMap puzzle correctly resets if you don't solve it and choose to exit the puzzle instead.

- [edit] Weapon construction is no longer hiding UI if exited without completion. 

I also got some reports concerning Linux and underwater area (and got a savegame so I can replicate the issue! Thank you!). I will be looking into these issues and try to fix them asap.

[/spoiler]
Once again thank you for playing the game and I hope that you enjoy it! 


Jan

notes.title: New update!
notes.notes:
Dear Earthlings,

today we are bringing you a large cumulative update of many things which has been reported to us. It's still not dealing with Linux achievements because I am unable to replicate the issue you are having, but it's not forgotten, just not easy to fix.

What does the patch fix?

* No 10 seconds waiting for menu on some computers
* Initial repair puzzle has been seriously shortened. It takes less time now and gets you exploring much faster
* Some Mission Data have now more clear text!
* Ambrosian no longer appears when he shouldn't
* Upgrade slider doesn't walk away from screen
* Log tabs shouldn't move out of the logbook
* Underwater frequency / pulse seek should no longer make the cursor disappear
* Textual changes and typo corrections
* Final credits change to include all the backers
* Some minor region size repairs

Enjoy,

Jan
